protocol: Two independent real batteries, both executed for real on 2026-09-13, no fabricated numbers. (1) Deterministic battery: every case was written into a scratch workspace and run through this task's own file_check verifier_specs (tests/manifest.json) via the vendored rl_world_verifiers.runner.run_verifier, covering the 7 metrics.json checks plus the CSV header/row-count check (8 deterministic file_check assertions total). (2) Rubric validation: the csv_rows_are_right rubric prompt was extracted LIVE from tests/manifest.json at run time (never hardcoded) and tested against 5 constructed CSV cases through a real call to the task's configured judge (glm-5.2 via the LiteLLM proxy, temperature 0.0), replicating tests/rl_world_verifiers/judge.py's system-prompt shape.

rubric_validation_summary.result: 5/5 cases behaved correctly: the byte-exact gold CSV PASSED, a reordered/requoted/re-whitespaced rendering of the identical gold values also PASSED (confirming the judge is not brittle to free formatting), and all 3 constructed wrong-value cases (channel-view-only undercount on data-v2-062, an extra non-problem room listed, and the wrong author attributed to a room) correctly FAILED. Judging the identical gold CSV twice at temperature 0 returned the same verdict both times.
